# Cogito

> Cogito is a self-hosted API key pool. It stores many API keys per provider (SerpAPI, ElevenLabs, or any API key based HTTP service), hands out a working key on demand, detects rate limits and quota exhaustion, cools keys down and rotates to the next one. Agents use it either as a proxy (Cogito injects the key, the secret is never exposed) or by leasing a key and reporting the outcome.

Base URL is wherever Cogito is deployed, for example `http://localhost:8080`. All consumer calls need an app token (`cog_...`) created in the dashboard. All bodies are JSON. Errors look like `{"error": {"code": "string", "message": "string"}}`.

Key facts for agents:

- Prefer proxy mode. Call `/proxy/{service}/{provider path}` exactly as you would call the provider, minus the provider key. Cogito retries with the next key on rate limits.
- Use lease mode only when you must hold the raw key (for example a provider SDK). Always report the outcome so bad keys cool down.
- HTTP 503 with code `no_key_available` means every key is cooling down or exhausted. Wait `retry_after_sec` seconds.
- An app may be limited to some services and to mode `proxy`, `lease` or `both`. Call `GET /api/v1/services` to see what you can use.

## Auth

- `Authorization: Bearer cog_...` (preferred), or `X-Cogito-Token: cog_...`.
- Proxy only: query parameter `?cogito_token=cog_...` for tools that only accept a URL.
- Cogito strips all three before forwarding upstream.

## Consumer API

- [GET /api/v1/services](/llms-full.txt#get-apiv1services): services this token may use, with `available`, `base_url` and `auth` `{type, name}`.
- [POST /api/v1/lease](/llms-full.txt#post-apiv1lease): body `{"service": "serpapi", "exclude_key_ids": [], "ttl_sec": 300}`, returns `{"lease_id", "key_id", "service", "secret", "auth": {"type", "name"}, "base_url", "expires_at"}`, or 503 `{"error": {"code": "no_key_available"}, "retry_after_sec": n}`.
- [POST /api/v1/leases/{lease_id}/report](/llms-full.txt#post-apiv1leaseslease_idreport): body `{"outcome", "status_code", "retry_after_sec", "message", "rotate"}`, returns `{"ok": true, "next": <lease or null>}`. With `rotate: true`, `next` is a fresh lease on another key.
- [ANY /proxy/{service}/{path}](/llms-full.txt#any-proxyservicepath): forwards to `base_url/{path}` with query string and body, injecting a key. Response headers add `X-Cogito-Key-Id` and `X-Cogito-Attempts`.
- [GET /healthz](/llms-full.txt#public-endpoints): `{"ok": true, "version": "..."}`, no auth.

## Outcomes

- `ok`: call succeeded, resets the key's failure counter.
- `rate_limited`: key cools down for `retry_after_sec`, or exponential backoff from the service cooldown, capped at 1h.
- `quota_exhausted`: key parked as `exhausted` until its quota resets (or 24h).
- `invalid`: key marked `invalid` and removed from rotation.
- `error`: provider or network failure that is not the key's fault. Key is not penalized.

## Proxy examples

- [SerpAPI search](/llms-full.txt#serpapi): `GET /proxy/serpapi/search.json?engine=google&q=coffee` with `Authorization: Bearer cog_...`. Do not send `api_key`.
- [ElevenLabs text to speech](/llms-full.txt#elevenlabs): `POST /proxy/elevenlabs/v1/text-to-speech/{voice_id}` with JSON `{"text": "Hello", "model_id": "eleven_multilingual_v2"}` and `Accept: audio/mpeg`. Do not send `xi-api-key`.

## MCP

- [POST /mcp](/llms-full.txt#mcp): MCP streamable HTTP endpoint (JSON responses), same app token auth. Tools: `list_services`, `get_key`, `report_key`, `pool_status`, `proxy_request`.

## SDKs

- [Python](/llms-full.txt#python): `pip install cogito-keys`, then `from cogito import Cogito`.
- [TypeScript and JavaScript](/llms-full.txt#typescript-and-javascript): `npm install @cogito/keys`, then `import { Cogito } from "@cogito/keys"`. Node 18+, Bun, Deno, browsers.
- [Go](/llms-full.txt#go): `go get github.com/cogito-keys/cogito-go`, package `cogito`.
- [PHP](/llms-full.txt#php): `composer require cogito/keys`, class `Cogito\Cogito`.
- [Ruby](/llms-full.txt#ruby): `gem install cogito-keys`, then `require "cogito"`.
